secondary.comment: HUD secondary accent (neon violet). Matches the homepage --cc-violet; used for secondary highlights (e.g. sidebar active gradient) so every surface shares the homepage's cyan+violet identity.

text.comment: Text-safe accent (HUD cyan). Reserved for accent-colored caption/authorship text; the bright cyan on the deep-navy surfaces composites well above WCAG AA. accent-default stays for fills/borders/focus/Core.

x.comment: Shared-light default (design §3.2/§12.1): normalized Core X. Runtime-updated <=1/frame by the Core render tick; this is the SSR/first-paint default.

y.comment: Shared-light default (design §3.2/§12.1): normalized Core Y (off-center light pool).

hue.comment: Shared-light default (design §3.2/§12.1): Core temperature within the accent family. Runtime-updated per state via the presence-* hue tokens; default resolves to the theme accent for first paint.

lean.comment: Shared-light default (design §3.2/§12.1): signed lean toward the Composer/arrival.

depth.comment: Shared-light signal (design §4.1, Req 2.6): signed Core depth — positive glides the Core forward (blocked/needs-you), negative recedes it (working/turn-active). Runtime-updated per state by the Core render tick; 0 at rest.

edge.comment: Environmental (design §3.1/§12.1): Room radial edge falling to near-black.

undertone.comment: Environmental (design §3.3/§12.1): interpolated time-of-day mood overlay. Default is no shift (transparent); runtime interpolates <=6% toward info (morning) / warning (night). Disabled under steady-lighting.

backing.comment: Reading Mode (design §11, Req 11.2): near-solid reading-column backing (deep navy) so body/caption text meets WCAG AA (>=4.5) over the receded Room.

dim.comment: Reading Mode (design §11, Req 11.2): hard-dim scrim over the receded Room so the atmosphere recedes behind text.

blur.comment: Glass/material (design §12.1): living-glass backdrop blur (single-layer; no stacked blurs per Req 17.2).

waiting.comment: Presence-state hue (design §4.1, Req 2.6/10.3): waiting/needs-you -> attention warning.

blocked.comment: Presence-state hue (design §4.1, Req 2.6/10.3): blocked/needs-approval -> attention warning.

recovering.comment: Presence-state hue (design §4.1): recovering -> cooling from danger.
